Contexts.Description: Lobby, sideline and world walking: the browser world's baseline mapping (Specs/Input_Architecture.md section 4).
The possessed pawn during play. APSPlayerController applies it on possessing an APSPlayerPawn (Epic 126); Epic 127 tunes its gamepad response.
Front-end and pause menus (Epic 101). Slate moves focus between buttons with the D-pad, stick or arrows; these rows name the keys menus treat as Confirm and Back.

Before the snap and after the whistle, while the human controls a player (Epic 104). UPSPlayContextComponent keeps exactly one of PreSnap, Passing, BallCarrier and Defense on the stack, above OnField.

The human's QB holds the ball behind the line of scrimmage (Epic 104.3). Each PassTarget button throws to a receiver slot, left to right across the field: a tap throws touch, a hold throws a bullet, and the Move stick places the ball. PumpFake sells a throw. Outranks OnField, so A, X and LB throw instead of hiking or switching.
The human's player holds the ball anywhere else: a runner, a receiver after the catch, a QB past the line. Epic 104.2's move set (juke, spin, truck, stiff-arm, hurdle, slide) binds here.
The human plays defense during the play. Epic 104.5's strip attempt binds here (RB); SwitchPlayer stays in OnField, so X and LB still switch.

The human's side kicks: a kickoff, punt or field goal (Epic 104.5). Kick works UPSKickMeterComponent's meter: hold to fill the power, release to lock it, press again to stop the accuracy needle. Outranks OnField, so A kicks instead of confirming.

A replay is playing (Epic 41): UPSReplaySubsystem pushes it on every player controller for the replay's length, over whatever the field had. Its transport and camera buttons win over the field's while it is on; Start still pauses, and the Move stick steers the free camera.

Before the snap while the human plays defense (Epic 104.5): PreSnap's offensive calls mean nothing to a defender, so he has his own buttons. JumpSnap binds here; X and LB still switch player from OnField.

Actions.Description: Move relative to the control rotation's yaw. X is right, Y is forward.
Turn the view. X is yaw, Y is pitch.
Override to full speed while held (APSPlayerPawn burst).
Accept or advance. A confirms in every context.
Back out or close. B cancels in every context.
Pause the game and open the pause menu (Epic 101). On the field Start pauses; off the field it opens the look picker.
Star or unstar the focused play on the play-call screens (Epic 102). Menus read it through Slate, like Back.
Take control of the ball carrier, or the teammate nearest the ball (Epic 127). Shares T / X with the world's take-over; LB is the shoulder-button alternative.
Talk to or use what you face.
Secondary interact: take over what you face.
Toggle third and first person. Y toggles the camera in every context.
Open the character / look picker (Epic 143). Start opens it off the field; on the field Start pauses.

Step the camera from the broadcast view through the all-22 coaches film rigs and back (Epic 40, UPSCameraAll22Component). R3 and F belong to no pass, move or pre-snap button, so the film view works before the snap and a press around the snap never cuts the camera.
Throw to receiver slot 1, the first eligible receiver from the left. Released after a tap: touch pass; held: bullet (UPSPassingComponent).
Throw to receiver slot 2, the second eligible receiver from the left. Released after a tap: touch pass; held: bullet (UPSPassingComponent).
Throw to receiver slot 3, the third eligible receiver from the left. Released after a tap: touch pass; held: bullet (UPSPassingComponent).
Throw to receiver slot 4, the fourth eligible receiver from the left. Released after a tap: touch pass; held: bullet (UPSPassingComponent).
Throw to receiver slot 5, the fifth eligible receiver from the left. Released after a tap: touch pass; held: bullet (UPSPassingComponent).
Sell a throw without making it: coverage that bites freezes for a moment (UPSDefenderAIComponent).
A hard cut toward the Move stick's side: tacklers whiff (Agility). UPSCarrierInputComponent; the move itself is Data/carrier_moves.json.
Spin through contact at a cost in speed (Agility 40+). UPSCarrierInputComponent; the move itself is Data/carrier_moves.json.
Lower the shoulder and power through (Strength 50+). UPSCarrierInputComponent; the move itself is Data/carrier_moves.json.
An arm bar that keeps a tackler off (Strength 30+). UPSCarrierInputComponent; the move itself is Data/carrier_moves.json.
Leap a low tackle (Agility 65+). UPSCarrierInputComponent; the move itself is Data/carrier_moves.json.

A defender times his get-off to the snap (Epic 104.5): pressed just before the snap, he bursts off the line at it; pressed earlier, he is offside. UPSDefenseInputComponent; the timing is Data/defensive_techniques.json.

A defender rips at the ball (Epic 104.5): for a moment his tackles are likelier to force a fumble and less likely to bring the carrier down. UPSDefenseInputComponent; the numbers are Data/defensive_techniques.json.
Work the kick meter (Epic 104.5): hold to fill the power, release to lock it, press again to stop the accuracy needle. UPSKickMeterComponent; the meter is Data/kick_meter.json.
Give yourself up: down at the next contact, with no hit and no fumble. UPSCarrierInputComponent; the move itself is Data/carrier_moves.json.
Check out of the call to the next play in the same formation (Epic 66). UPSPreSnapInputComponent; the rules are UPSPreSnapSubsystem's.
Pick the receiver the hot route, motion and protection buttons act on: the next one left to right across the field (Epic 66).
Send the selected receiver on the next route his alignment allows (Epic 66, Data/presnap_tuning.json).
Send the selected receiver in motion across the formation; a defender who travels with him shows man coverage (Epic 66).
Slide the line's protection: none, left, right (Epic 66).
Keep the selected back or tight end in to block, or release him into a route (Epic 66).

Before the snap, on offense: cycle the tempo, huddle / no-huddle / hurry-up (Epic 76). Hurry-up reruns your last play with no call screen. UPSPlayCallComponent; the tempos are Data/situational_tuning.json.
Before the snap: call a timeout for your side, which stops the clock if you have one left (Epic 76). UPSPlayCallComponent.
Before the snap, take control of the nearest teammate to the left across the field: a flick of the right stick (Epic 30, UPSControlHandoffComponent).
Before the snap, take control of the nearest teammate to the right across the field (Epic 30, UPSControlHandoffComponent).
The defense checks to the next play of its front before the snap (Epic 67, UPSDefenderPreSnapInputComponent; the call is UPSDefenderPreSnapSubsystem's).
Before the snap, the defense selects the next offensive receiver, left to right across the field, for Shadow (Epic 67, UPSDefenderPreSnapInputComponent).

The AI defensive back lined up nearest the selected receiver shadows him: he lines up over him and plays man on him at the snap, whatever the call. Pressed again, he lets him go (Epic 67, UPSDefenderPreSnapInputComponent).
Linebackers walk up to show a blitz that isn't coming; press again to back off (Epic 67, UPSDefenderPreSnapInputComponent; how far and how many are Data/defensive_presnap.json).

The safeties show the other coverage shell, two-high for one-high or the reverse, and rotate to their real zones at the snap; press again to show the real one (Epic 67, UPSDefenderPreSnapInputComponent).
The blitzers line up in coverage and creep up late, blitzing at the snap; press again to line up honestly (Epic 67, UPSDefenderPreSnapInputComponent).
Pause the replay, or play it on (from its end, from the start). A, as A confirms everywhere.
Step the replay's speed through Data/replay.json's PlaybackRates: real time, half, quarter.
Hold the replay and step back one captured frame.
Hold the replay and step on one captured frame.
While held, scrub the replay backward at ScrubSecondsPerSecond.
While held, scrub the replay forward at ScrubSecondsPerSecond.

Step the replay's camera through Data/replay.json's Cameras: the director, the all-22 rigs, the skycam, the free camera (which circles the ball on the Move stick). Y, as Y toggles the camera off the field.
Leave the replay and go back to the game. B, as B cancels everywhere.
